status: REGISTERED BEFORE ANY DETECTION IS RUN ON AN EXPANDED WINDOW AND BEFORE ANY COVERAGE METRIC IS COMPUTED. thresholds.json and baseline-v0 are unchanged and govern shot classification. Nothing here may change after results exist: add criteria-v2.json and say so. This experiment is NOT adaptive unless a later file says otherwise.
disclosure: Written after (a) Experiment 1, which found the release observed in 1 of 174 counted shots (but with a machine definition that only linked tracks to a shot once they reached the rim zone, so part of that number is the machine, not the window), and (b) a first look at full 1920x1080 frames of ten clips (contact sheets with the window drawn on them): in six of eight clips the shooter and the release stand outside the 416 px window or at its edge, and in the two with a large window (IMG_4866, scale 1.9) the shooter is inside it. No clip shows the ball leaving the camera frame in the sheets viewed. The design below reflects that look. No result of any expanded window exists yet.

data.not_used: IMG_4836 and IMG_4844 have no saved ball-6 detections and a different or unknown window; B1689585 (kids clip) has no make/miss list. All other recordings (IMG_4824-4835) are earlier test footage without a written shot list.
data.limits: no untouched footage; ball-6 was trained on every clip except IMG_4874, so detections on the others are optimistic; every number is a re-test on used recordings and says nothing about independent generalisation. The live app receives 1280x720 camera frames (the registry clips are 1920x1080): window geometry in pixels is not transferable, only the ball size in the window (about 24 px) is.
data.shot_sample: per clip, the shots that baseline-v0 counted AND matched to a written shot (the aligned pairs, as in the baseline), sorted by first zone sighting F; every k-th with k = ceil(n / 10), starting with the first; at most 10 per clip. Detection is run only on frames F-75 .. F+15 of each sampled shot (30 fps); the 15 fps results use the even frames of the same segments. Chosen for compute (an inference is about 0.12 s on this Mac), not for any property of the shots.

coordinate_unit: base-window pixels: u = (native - window origin) / window scale, the unit of every saved detection and of the Experiment-1 tracker. The base window is [0,416]^2 in it; a ball is about 24 px wide in it by construction of the auto-sizer. Boxes from any tile are mapped native -> u, so strategies are comparable and the Experiment-1 gates (px per reference frame) keep their meaning.

strategies.S0_fixed: the production window alone (the saved ball-6 detections of those frames; the segment run also re-runs it, and must reproduce them: parity check). 1 inference per processed frame.
strategies.A1: ONE window centred on the base window, side 1.5 x base side (clamped to the frame), shrunk to 416. 1 inference.
strategies.A2: ONE window centred on the base window, side 2.0 x base side (clamped to 1080), shrunk to 416. 1 inference.
strategies.A3_full_frame_reference: the whole 1920x1080 frame letterboxed to 416 (ball about 5 px). 1 inference. A reference extreme, expected to fail; included because a larger window must not be assumed better.
strategies.tile_grid: nine windows of the base side at the base scale: the base window and eight neighbours shifted by 0.75 x side (25% overlap) in x and/or y, clamped inside the frame, duplicates after clamping merged. The ball is the same size in every tile (about 24 px), the size the detector expects. Detections of overlapping tiles are merged by non-maximum suppression (IoU 0.4, best score kept).
strategies.B_second_window: base window plus ONE neighbour tile, 2 inferences per frame. Candidates: up, left, right, up-left, up-right (down tiles are not candidates: a ball below the window is not in flight). The headline B is the single relative offset with the highest pooled release-observed share on the DEVELOPMENT clips, reported on validation and diagnostic clips unseen by that choice; all five are reported.
strategies.C_dynamic: ONE tile per frame, chosen from the nine by a policy that sees only past detections: TRACK state (a detection of score >= 0.4 in any of the last 4 processed frames): the tile whose centre is nearest the constant-velocity prediction of the last detection; IDLE state: C_scan cycles through the nine tiles one per processed frame in the order base, up, up-left, left, down-left, down, down-right, right, up-right; C_follow stays on the base tile. A detection can only be seen if the chosen tile contains it. 1 inference.
strategies.D_all_tiles: all nine tiles every frame, 9 inferences. The coverage upper bound at the expected input scale, not a deployable candidate on a phone that spends 39-68 ms per inference in a 66 ms (15 fps) loop.

observation_definitions.chain: detections of score >= 0.25 linked by the Experiment-1 tracker with the cv_nearest associator (the simple constant-velocity nearest-neighbour reference), fed only the strategy's detections; the shot's chain is the one that reaches the rim zone nearest F (track containing the first zone sighting; if several tracks, the longest ending at F).
observation_definitions.flight_points: the chain's observed points before F that are moving (speed >= 3 px per reference frame over 3 frames)
observation_definitions.release_observed: the chain contains at least 3 observed points with speed < 4 px per reference frame (held ball) immediately followed, with no gap above 2 frames, by at least 3 observed points whose speed rises through 8 px per reference frame (airborne), all before F. 'Immediately followed' is in time, within the same chain. Nothing is interpolated or fitted for this test.
observation_definitions.apex_observed: among the chain's observed points before F, the minimum-y point is interior (at least 3 observed points on each side), is at least 12 px above the first and the last observed point, and the observed gaps within 3 frames of it are at most 2 frames. A fitted parabola is never used to claim an apex.
observation_definitions.rim_approach_observed: at least 3 observed descending points in the band 50-120 px above the rim in the 20 frames before F
observation_definitions.continuous_flight: from the first flight point to F no gap longer than 2 processed frames (strict variant: no gap at all) between observed points
observation_definitions.gaps: runs of processed frames without an observed point of the chain between its first flight point and F; counts and lengths in reference frames
observation_definitions.reconstruction_eligible: at least 8 observed flight points, a maximum gap of 3 frames, and observed points on both the rising and the falling side of the minimum-y point

estimators.E1: the first observed point of the airborne run where speed exceeds 8 px per reference frame, minus one frame (the last held frame)
estimators.E2: the time at which a quadratic fit (x linear, y quadratic) to the first 8 observed airborne points, extrapolated backwards, comes within one ball width of the centroid of the held points

release_feasibility.repeatability: agreement of E1 and E2 in frames at 30 fps and at 15 fps, on release-observed shots; sanity check by eye of 12 shots on contact strips (labelled a plausibility check by one annotator, not ground truth)
release_feasibility.precision_not_claimed_beyond: one frame at 30 fps is 33 ms; timing is reported in frames and never as sub-frame precision; release position is reported in base-window px, not metres

ground_truth.recall_frames: 40 full frames, 4 per sampled shot for 10 shots drawn with seed 20261101 from the development and validation clips, at F-60, F-45, F-30, F-15; the ball (visible or not) is annotated by eye on the native frame by one annotator, blind to every detection, before any detection of an expanded window is read. Annotated centre match radius 0.75 ball diameters.
ground_truth.precision_review: every strategy's detections of score >= 0.25 that lie outside the S0 window or are not matched to an S0 detection, sampled with seed 20261102 (up to 40 per strategy, stratified by clip), cropped and labelled ball / not ball / unsure by eye before the tracker or the metrics are computed on them.

criteria.X1_parity: the segment re-run of the base window reproduces the saved S0 detections on at least 99% of detections (position within 1.5 px, same frame). Otherwise the frame alignment is wrong and nothing is reported.
criteria.X2_release_visibility: release_observed for at least 50% of sampled shots pooled, and at least 25 percentage points above S0, at 30 fps AND 15 fps; per-clip table reported; a clip with fewer than 6 sampled shots is reported but not counted for a per-clip statement
criteria.X3_apex_visibility: apex_observed at least 20 percentage points above S0, pooled, at both frame rates
criteria.X4_rim_approach_no_loss: rim_approach_observed within 2 percentage points of S0 or better, pooled, at both frame rates
criteria.X5_retention: at least 95% of S0 detections of score >= 0.4 inside the base window, of the sampled segments, are reproduced by the strategy within 0.5 ball widths (same frame); for D this is by construction and is reported
criteria.X6_recall: on the 40 annotated frames: where the annotated ball lies outside the S0 window, recall at least 15 points above S0; where it lies inside, recall within 2 points of S0 or better
criteria.X7_false_positives: of the sampled extra detections at score >= 0.25: at least 90% ball; and the number of new detections per processed frame outside S0 that are not ball (from the review, scaled to the unsampled population) at most 0.25
criteria.X8_continuity: continuous_flight (gap <= 2) share at least 20 points above S0 pooled at both frame rates
criteria.X9_reconstruction: reconstruction_eligible for at least 70% of sampled shots pooled at both frame rates
criteria.X10_cost: extra inferences per processed frame at most 1 (two runs in all) for a phone-compatible label; latency reported as inference calls x the measured desktop time and as the documented phone figure (39-68 ms per ball-5 inference); a strategy needing 9 runs is labelled research-only, whatever it scores
criteria.X11_compatibility: reported by reading src/lib/vision/{roi,counting,autoSize,shotRules}.ts and src/components: what the app would have to change (second crop, merge, coordinate mapping); no production edit
criteria.X12_production_unchanged: git diff of src/ and public/ over the experiment is empty; baseline-v0, thresholds.json, datasets.lock verify; app tests (training/tools/43-run-tests.mjs, 93) and harness tests pass

decision_rule: A strategy is RECOMMENDED FOR AN INTEGRATION EXPERIMENT only if X1 holds and X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X10 (phone-compatible) hold at both frame rates. If no phone-compatible strategy does, the report says which criteria each misses and what the research-only upper bound (D) shows is available in the footage. Improvement is claimed only where a criterion defines it. Nothing is promoted into src/ without Matt's approval.
reported_not_required: per-clip tables at both frame rates for every strategy
ball width in u px by position in the flight (apex, release, rim)
where the ball is when it first appears (outside window share, top of frame, field-of-view exits)
chain fragmentation (chains per shot) for cv_nearest on each strategy against S0
the Experiment-1 Kalman associator on the same detections, labelled experimental
the shooter-visibility and shooter-occlusion judgements from the contact sheets
limits_to_state_in_the_report: no untouched footage and no ground truth for release timing
ball-6 saw most of these clips in training
single annotator for recall and precision labels
image-space numbers only: uncalibrated 2D positions are not metres, angles or 3D
the app's live frames are 1280x720, these are 1920x1080
desktop WASM timings are not phone timings
tile positions are relative to the base window, which the production auto-sizer would choose itself and may place differently
